name: Post Goods Receipt for Purchase Order
objective: Post a Goods Receipt against the Purchase Order created in the previous stage, confirming the delivered quantity into the target storage location, and capture the resulting Material Document number.
preconditions: The Purchase Order exists and has open (undelivered) quantity; a valid storage location is configured for the receiving plant.
learningObjectives: After this section you can search the Post Goods Receipt app by Purchase Order number.
After this section you can confirm the delivered quantity for each open line item.
After this section you can post the goods receipt and capture the resulting Material Document number.
commonErrorsAndTips: The storage location must be selected explicitly (this app requires a value-help pick, not free-text) — the Post button stays disabled without it.
Delivered Quantity greater than the open PO quantity. The system either blocks the posting or flags an over-delivery warning; confirm quantity against the PO's own open balance first.
Searching by an already-consumed Purchase Order shows no open line items. This usually means the PO has already been fully received, not that the search failed.

The Post action can silently fail to update inventory if the material lacks a valid batch/serial profile it requires. Check the message log at the top of the screen if the confirmation dialog doesn't appear as expected.
